pages.text: A body-slot paged organ freezer: $(bold)9 pages × 9 slots = 81 slots$() + a 9-slot pipe buffer.$(br2)Organs $(bold)auto-sort$() into the page of their body slot (eyes to the eye page, heart to the heart page...) - you always know where everything is.

Organs need life energy to stay active: 1 per tick. When depleted they go $(bold)dormant$() (UI warning; access still works) and wake once recharged.$(br2)Inputs must match their page; output is drawn from the buffer by pipes.
